name: Boughs in the Wind

angles.text: As fewer youths show a gift for magic each passing year, shaping a traditional spell focus helps preserve your people’s ancestral culture in Zephras.
Shaping a spell focus from a wind-touched bough marks an early rite for spellcasters learning to channel elemental resonance.

aliases: what is boughs in the wind
faq.answer: Apprentices gather a wind-touched fallen branch to shape a spell focus. This old rite helps preserve Zephras’s magical heritage.
faq.q: What is the quest Boughs in the Wind?

faq.answer: Belann Windwood is a mentor in Valanaar who guides young spellcasters as they shape their spell focuses. He worries that fewer people show a gift for magic each passing year.
The boughs fall from the oldest trees near the wind shrine just south of Falaath Village. Belann directs apprentices there because ancient wood retains traces of elemental currents.
faq.q: Where do you find the Wind-Infused Bough?

faq.answer: Apprentices shape their own spell focus after showing a gift for magic. It channels elemental energies and marks their passage into an old cultural rite.
faq.q: Why do young spellcasters create a spell focus?

faq.answer: Belann Windwood says tradition holds that a branch often chooses its spellcaster. A fitting bough may seem to sing to someone sensitive to elemental winds.
faq.q: Why does Belann ask if the branch sang to you?

faq.answer: Fewer people in Zephras are born with a natural gift for magic each passing year. Belann believes keeping the old rites alive matters all the more.
faq.q: What is happening to magic in Zephras?

sections.body: Young spellcasters in Zephras begin this old rite when they show a gift for magic. In Valanaar, Belann Windwood guides apprentices as they gather a fallen branch from the region’s oldest trees. The boughs keep traces of wind, making them fit to channel spells.
sections.title: A Rite of Passage

sections.body: The strongest boughs lie near the wind shrine just south of Falaath Village, where elemental currents gather. Tradition says a branch may choose its spellcaster, and some say it sings softly to those able to wield its power. For elders like Belann, each apprentice who completes the rite helps carry their culture forward. Fewer people in Zephras are born with a gift for magic each passing year.
sections.title: Whispers at the Wind Shrine

summary: In Valanaar, Belann Windwood guides apprentices through the old rite of shaping a spell focus. They seek a wind-touched branch near Falaath Village, as fewer people in Zephras are born with a gift for magic.
